title: Bug: invalid broadcast set if using /31 subnet for mgmt
author: matuskosut
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

invalid broadcast (None) is set if using /31 subnet for mgmt, this breaks configuration

### Steps to Reproduce

set mgmt interface with /31 subnet

```
  "MGMT_INTERFACE": {
    "eth0|10.10.4.13/31": {
      "gwaddr": "10.10.4.12"
    }
  }
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

actual behaviour - affected part of /etc/network/interfaces:

```
# The management network interface
auto eth0
iface eth0 inet static
    address 10.10.4.13
    netmask 255.255.255.254
    network 10.10.4.12
    broadcast None
    vrf mgmt
```

expected behaviour, do not render broadcast if none:

```
```
# The management network interface
auto eth0
iface eth0 inet static
    address 10.10.4.13
    netmask 255.255.255.254
    network 10.10.4.12
    vrf mgmt
```


### Relevant log output

```shell
warning: eth0: convert string ip address into IPNetwork object: 'None' does not appear to be an IPv4 or IPv6 address
```

linkedPullRequests.title: [cfggen] Fix invalid broadcast address for /31 and /32 mgmt subnets
linkedPullRequests.author: rustiqly
linkedPullRequests.body:
## Description

When a management interface uses a /31 or /32 subnet (RFC 3021 point-to-point links), `netaddr.IPNetwork.broadcast` returns `None`. The `prefix_attr()` function in `sonic-cfggen` converts this to the string `"None"` via `str()`, which then renders literally as `broadcast None` in `/etc/network/interfaces`.

This causes ifupdown to emit warnings and breaks network configuration:
```
warning: eth0: convert string ip address into IPNetwork object:
'None' does not appear to be an IPv4 or IPv6 address
```

**Affected subnets:**
- IPv4: /31, /32
- IPv6: /127, /128

### Fix

Two changes (defense in depth):

1. **`sonic-cfggen` `prefix_attr()`**: Check for `None` before calling `str()`, returning `None` instead of the string `"None"`.

2. **`interfaces.j2`**: Guard the broadcast line with `{% if prefix | broadcast %}` so it is omitted when the broadcast address is `None`.

### Before (broken)
```
iface eth0 inet static
    address 10.10.4.13
    netmask 255.255.255.254
    network 10.10.4.12
    broadcast None     ← invalid
```

### After (fixed)
```
iface eth0 inet static
    address 10.10.4.13
    netmask 255.255.255.254
    network 10.10.4.12
                       ← broadcast line correctly omitted
```

Normal subnets (/24, /64, etc.) are unaffected — broadcast line still renders as before.

## Test added
- New minigraph test data (`t0-sample-graph-mgmt31.xml`) with /31 mgmt interface
- Expected output (`interfaces_mgmt31`) verifying broadcast line is omitted for /31
- Test case in `test_j2files.py::test_interfaces`

Fixes: #25150

comments.body:
## Verified on sonic-vs VM

**Environment:** SONiC master (fcf18f7e0), Python 3.13.5, Debian 13.3

**Bug reproduction (unpatched) — /31 mgmt subnet:**
```
    broadcast None     ← invalid
```

**Fix verification (patched `prefix_attr()` + template guard):**

/31 subnet — broadcast correctly omitted:
```
iface eth0 inet static
    address 10.10.4.13
    netmask 255.255.255.254
    network 10.10.4.12
    ########## management network policy routing rules
```

/24 subnet — broadcast preserved (regression check):
```
iface eth0 inet static
    address 10.0.0.100
    netmask 255.255.255.0
    network 10.0.0.0
    broadcast 10.0.0.255
    ########## management network policy routing rules
```

IPv6 /64 — broadcast preserved (regression check):
```
iface eth0 inet6 static
    address 2603:10e2:0:2902::8
    netmask 64
    network 2603:10e2:0:2902::
    broadcast 2603:10e2:0:2902:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff
    ########## management network policy routing rules
```
